title: Stability-oriented design of a MoO3/TAPC hybrid bilayer hole transport layer for scalable organic solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01315A, Paper
Ji Youn Kim, Ye Chan Kim, Doo Kyung Moon
By implementing the MoO3/TAPC hybrid bilayer structure in inverted OSCs, the device achieved a PCE of 16.49% for unit cells and 13.95% for mini-modules, demonstrating exceptional long-term operational photostability.
